Messages.Author: Andrew Rowanbranch
Messages.Body:
Hi!

I was wondering if someone uses Theft of Vitae, does this count as "damage"
on my minion, or doesn't blood-stealing count as damage for these kinds of
effects?

I was thinking that it should count as damage, since you can't prevent it...

Thanks in advance
- Andrew

Messages.Author: bingotclown
Messages.Body:
"Andrew Rowanbranch" <rowan...@bigfoot.com> wrote in message
news:NPhz8.3279$iB4....@nntpserver.swip.net...

> Hi!
>
> I was wondering if someone uses Theft of Vitae, does this count as
"damage"
> on my minion, or doesn't blood-stealing count as damage for these kinds of
> effects?

Theft of Vitae does not do damage and therefor cannot be used in conjunction
with Taste of vitae. It's a steal blood strike. I'm sure that someone in a
in an official role will confirm this.

John
